Foam/adhesive rear retainer; headerless module. Final glass offset and cable egress require sample verification.
Pull toward heel by 5 mm before turning collar; push forward after locking. Captive under rails with M2 shoulder screw. No spring or automatic relock is claimed.

One of two collar halves assembled around fixed shoulders using two M2 through bolts and nuts at X151.5/Z+/-29. Rotate -30 degrees after retracting slider. Validate screw bearing, print fit, fatigue and torque.
Matching collar half. Split is away from head lugs. 0.30 mm seam. Fasteners are installed once; head changes require no screw removal.
R03 vibration chamber with new stationary four-contact connection and common collar lugs.
Retained R03 dome and coin motor pocket. Cleaning/contact-surface validation is unresolved; no disposable barrier has been validated.
Exact pilot, key and lugs. Use with female coupon and collar before a complete handle print.
Exact socket and collar shoulders. Assemble the two collar halves around this coupon using the same M2 through bolts.
R04 mechanical twist-lock interface. Four M3 x 8 button-head bolts join the head chassis. Electrical contacts are a separate unfinished R04 subsystem; use the cable port for initial bench testing.

Print open side upward. Includes 2.0 mm compression and 0.6 mm extension stops, printed-cassette pads, M3 nut pockets and cable exit. Clear holes and fit coupons first; no sliding bearing touches the carriage during measurement.

Curved white hood. Four M3 x 35 screws enter from underside; insert their nuts into underside cover pockets first. Service pin is M3 x 30 with its head seating at Z24; remove completely for measurement. Print crown upward with accessible support below.
Optional decorative inlay, 1.1 mm thick. Bond into the shallow crown recess with a thin compatible adhesive film. No force-sensing function. Print flat in teal.

Replaceable planar printed flexure, no rubbing guide. Two M2 x 8 underside screws attach the moving rail to the posts. Insert their nuts through side slots before assembly. Magnet pocket 6.4 x 3.4 mm; M2 retained cap. R04 bayonet plus added M2 lock screw. Large rear shoulder meets chassis overload stops. Service-pin bore is in the large travel-stop shoulder.
Two M2 x 10 screws; opening is smaller than magnet diameter. Thin adhesive layer prevents movement within the clearance pocket.

DRV5055A3QLPG TO-92 pocket: 4.6 mm width, 3.3 mm depth, open top. Flat sensing face toward magnet. ±1 mm axial adjustment gives nominal 7.2–9.2 mm package-face gap. Two M3 x 6 screws; strain-relieve stationary wires.

Same R04 quarter-turn geometry, plus radial M2 lock pocket; press flange against receiver face while clamping. Unrated nylon references only. Cartridge lock screw must be loosened before turning; install service pin first.
Rigid broad pad for pressing against a reference balance; NEVER a skin-testing substitute. Swap for filament cartridge after mechanical/sensor calibration; recalibrate assembled cartridge as needed.
Bond over the M3 x 30 socket head. REMOVE ENTIRE SCREW for measurement. Pin is only for cartridge changes and cassette assembly; not a travel-adjustment screw.
Bond over M2 x 12 head. Back out at least 3 mm before rotating cartridge; use service lock while doing so.

Baseline replaceable cassette: 0.8 mm beams, 24 mm root-line span, 2.4 mm height, 0.6 mm root fillets. Print flat, no support. Four M2 x 8 screws. Experimental PLA bench spring; not calibrated or fatigue-qualified.
Alternative complete cassette with 1.0 mm beams. Install ONE cassette only. Print and compare stiffness/drift; width is not a force rating. Flat print, no support.
Alternative complete cassette with 1.2 mm beams. Install ONE cassette only. Print and compare stiffness/drift; width is not a force rating. Flat print, no support.
Left to right holes 2.2 / 2.4 / 3.2 / 3.4 mm; Ø6.4 x 3.5 magnet pocket; 4.6 x 3.3 TO92 pocket. Hex pockets AF4.5 / AF5.8. Print before full head.
Exact front of R08 carriage including lock pocket and R04 bayonet track. Test with part 48 before full carriage.

Temporary open assembly fixture: replaces lid using the two front M3 x 35 underside screws and two M3 nuts in its underside pockets, holds the M3 x 30 service pin while leaving both fixed cassette screws accessible. Three extra M3 nuts. Remove bridge before fitting lid; never leave it inside the head.
